entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I need to make a return. I have an order number if you need it.
I can certainly help with that. Please go ahead with the order number.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order here for a VeloFit Performance jersey. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's simply the wrong size. I ordered a medium, but it's just too tight across the shoulders. I was hoping to start an exchange or just return it.
I understand completely. Let me just check the delivery date. It looks like it was delivered 57 days ago. And just to confirm, this isn't a technical fault, just a sizing preference, correct?
Correct, no defect. It's a great jersey, just not the right fit for me.
Not a problem at all. Our policy for standard apparel allows for returns within 10 days, so you're unfortunately outside that window. I can approve this return for a full refund for you right now.

That's great news, I appreciate it. Now, since I'm going through the process of packaging it up and sending it back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future order? Maybe 10% to apply to the correct size?

I can definitely appreciate you asking. While I'm not able to add a discount code on top of a full refund, I can confirm that the return shipping is completely free. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now, so there will be no cost on your end to send the jersey back to us.
Okay, that's fair. A free shipping label works for me. Thank you for sorting that out so quickly.
You're very welcome. You should see that email in the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, Alex.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
